parole.testo: From Ancient Greek δυσ- (dus-) + Latin calculare.

parole.significato: genocide (the systematic killing of substantial numbers of people on the basis of their ethnicity, religion, or nationa…
parole.testo: Apparently coined by Polish legal scholar Raphael Lemkin in 1943 or 1944 in reference to the Armenian Genocide and the Jewish Holocaust. From the stem of Ancient Greek γένος (génos, “race, kind”) + Latin -cīda (“killing, killer”).

parole.significato: melodeclamation (practice of reciting poetry while accompanied by concert music)
parole.testo: Internationalism; compare English melodeclamation, German Melodeklamation, Russian мелодекламация (melodeklamacija). Ultimately from Ancient Greek μέλος (mélos) + Latin dēclāmātiō. By surface analysis, melo- + deklamacja.
